IGHUD,DifficultyDescQuiet: The one upstairs is less sensitive to sound and chases you more slowly.
IGHUD,DifficultyDescStandard: Even small noises matter as you explore. This is the default difficulty.
IGHUD,DifficultyDescHasty: The one upstairs hears quieter sounds and keeps chasing you for longer.
IGHUD,DifficultyDescListenOnly: The one upstairs still approaches sounds, but never chases or catches you. Every puzzle and ending is available.
IGHUD,A11yHintsDesc: Each press of the hint key gives a little more detail about where to look. When off, the hint key does nothing.
IGHUD,A11yReducedMotionDesc: Reduces camera shake while you walk or are being chased.
IGHUD,A11yReducedFlickerDesc: Reduces rapid flickering from the flashlight and other lights.
IGHUD,A11yFieldOfViewDesc: Changes how much you can see at once. If the view feels cramped or makes you dizzy, set it to whatever feels comfortable.
IGHUD,A11yVignetteDesc: Darkens the edges of the screen, so less of your surroundings is visible while you move.
IGHUD,A11yCameraTextureDesc: Adds subtle lens distortion around the edges. Turn it down if your eyes get tired.
IGHUD,A11yCenterDotDesc: By default, a dot appears in the center of the screen only when you aim at something to examine. If you feel dizzy, set it to Always. It gives your eyes a fixed point.
IGHUD,A11yFearDirectionDesc: Shows the direction of important sounds at the edge of the screen.
IGHUD,A11yKnockRingDesc: Sounds from the one upstairs appear as thin rings. Sounds you make appear as thick rings.
IGHUD,A11yKnockHapticDesc: The gamepad vibrates when the one upstairs makes a sound. More distant sounds produce weaker vibrations.
IGHUD,A11yHeartbeatDesc: When you’re tense, the edges of the screen pulse with your heartbeat.
IGHUD,A11yKnockAssistDesc: Knocks still count if your timing is a little early or late.
IGHUD,A11ySoundCaptionsDesc: Shows the sounds that matter, like knocks and footsteps, as text.
IGHUD,A11yCaptionSizeDesc: Changes the text size of both dialogue and sound captions. You can preview it below.
IGHUD,A11yCaptionBackgroundDesc: Sets how dark the background behind captions is.
IGHUD,A11yCaptionSafeAreaDesc: Lower values move captions in from the edges of the screen.
IGHUD,A11yCaptionDurationDesc: Changes how long captions stay on screen. Raise it if you need more time to read.
IGHUD,A11yCrouchInputDesc: Choose whether one press toggles crouching, or you crouch only while holding the key.
IGHUD,A11yHoldInputDesc: Instead of holding the button for interactions, press once to start and press again to cancel.
IGHUD,A11yHoldDurationDesc: Sets how long you hold the button to open doors or examine things.
IGHUD,A11yPromptKeysDesc: Set to Always, prompts always show the key to press. Set to While Learning, the key name is dropped once you’ve done the same action three times.
IGHUD,A11yHapticsDesc: Turns gamepad vibration on or off.
IGHUD,A11yMicrophoneDesc: When on, the one upstairs reacts to your voice and sounds around you. When off, the microphone isn’t used.
IGHUD,A11yResetDesc: Resets the settings on this screen to their defaults.
IGHUD,A11yCloseDesc: Saves your settings and returns to the previous screen.

IGHUD,AudioCalibrationKnockInstruction:
Set it so the knocking is clear
but doesn’t make you jump.
IGHUD,AudioCalibrationShadowInstruction:
Adjust until the middle square is barely visible.
The left square should blend into the background.
IGHUD,AudioCalibrationBusNote: Music and ambience have separate volume controls. Knocks and sounds from the one upstairs follow Master Volume.
IGHUD,AudioCalibrationOutputSpeakers: Plays audio tuned for speakers. If directions are hard to tell apart, turn on Sound Captions.
IGHUD,AudioCalibrationControlsGamepad: D-pad Navigate/Adjust  ·  A Select  ·  B Cancel
IGHUD,AudioCalibrationControlsKeyboard: Arrows/WASD Navigate/Adjust  ·  Enter Select  ·  Esc Cancel  ·  Mouse Select
IGHUD,Display.WindowModeDesc: Switches between fullscreen and windowed modes. If you don’t confirm within 10 seconds, it goes back to the previous setting.
IGHUD,Display.ResolutionDesc: Changes the screen resolution. Matching your monitor’s resolution gives the sharpest image.
IGHUD,Display.QualityDesc: Adjusts the quality of shadows, reflections, and more. Lower it if the game stutters.
IGHUD,Display.VSyncDesc: Reduces screen tearing, where the image looks split horizontally. Controls may feel slightly less responsive.
IGHUD,Display.FrameLimitDesc: Sets the maximum frames per second. A lower limit can reduce heat and power use.
IGHUD,Display.LanguageDesc: Changes the language of on-screen text. Takes effect immediately.
IGHUD,Display.AccessibilityDesc: Sets difficulty, captions, camera shake, and control assists.
IGHUD,Display.AudioBrightnessDesc: Adjusts the volume and screen brightness.
IGHUD,Display.ControlsDesc: Changes the keys and gamepad buttons for each action. Esc and F10 can’t be changed.
IGHUD,Display.ReapplyDesc: Applies the current display settings again.
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsSubtitle: Adjust resolution, graphics quality, and language.
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsConfirmCountdown: Keep these display settings? Reverting automatically in {0}s.
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsConfirmControlsGame: A Keep  ·  B/View Revert  ·  Or select Revert below
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsConfirmControlsKeyb: Enter/Click Keep  ·  Esc Revert  ·  Or select Revert below
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsControlsGamepad: D-pad Navigate/Adjust  ·  A Select  ·  B/View Cancel
IGHUD,DisplaySettingsControlsKeyboard: Arrows/WASD Navigate/Adjust  ·  Enter Select  ·  Esc Cancel  ·  Mouse Select
IGHUD,LookDetail: Mouse and gamepad sensitivity are set separately. Raise Vertical Sensitivity to look up and down faster.
IGHUD,KeyBindingsFixedNote: Esc (Pause) and F10 (Accessibility) can’t be changed. Gamepad buttons use the Xbox layout.
IGHUD,KeyBindingsControlsPad: D-pad ↑↓ Navigate · ←→ Change value/device · A Rebind · B Back
IGHUD,KeyBindingsControlsKeys: ↑↓ Navigate · ←→ Change value/device · Enter Rebind · Esc Back
IGHUD,NoticeSensory1: Includes jump scares, loud noises, dark scenes, camera shake and flickering lights.
IGHUD,NoticeSensory2: If the visuals or sounds feel uncomfortable, take a break or adjust the settings.
IGHUD,NoticeThemes1: Includes a scene with a dead body and a section where you hear someone dying.
IGHUD,NoticeThemes2: This fictional story deals with a missing person, a dispute between neighbors, and an illegally built room.
IGHUD,NoticeControls1: You can reduce camera shake and light flicker in Accessibility.
IGHUD,NoticeControls2: If being chased is too much, try the “No Chase” difficulty. Every ending is reachable on any difficulty.
IGHUD,Menu.ThisGameIsMadeToBeHeardOnHead: Headphones make it easier to tell where sounds are coming from.
IGHUD,Menu.SelectNewGameAgainToStart: Press again to start a new game
IGHUD,SystemMenuControlsGamepad: D-pad Navigate  ·  A Select  ·  View Back
IGInput,DescGuide: Shows your objective and the controls for 10 seconds. Press again to close.
IGInput,RebindReserved: That key is reserved for Pause and Accessibility.
IGInput,RebindNeedsPad: Only gamepad buttons can go in the Gamepad column.
IGInput,RebindNeedsKeyboard: Only keyboard keys or mouse buttons can go in the Keyboard column.
IGInput,RebindConflict: “{0}” already uses that key. Change that one first.
IGInput,DescSprint: Run fast. Your footsteps and breathing get louder.
IGInput,DescInteract: Examine objects or open doors. Hold to open doors quietly.
IGInput,DescKnock: Knock on doors or walls. Listen for what comes back.
IGInput,DescListen: Press your ear to the wall and listen. On keyboard, face the wall and hold the Interact key.
IGInput,DescHoldBreath: Hold your breath for a moment. Hold it too long and you’ll gasp for air.
IGInput,DescFlashlight: Turn the flashlight on or off. The one upstairs can hear the switch, too.
IGInput,DescJump: Jump over low obstacles. Landing makes noise.
IGInput,DescJournal: During the day, review the clues you’ve found so far.
IGInput,DescHint: When you’re stuck, Yudam thinks of where to look. Each press gets a little more specific.
IGInput,DescLoadAutosave: Restart from the latest autosave. Not available during the night.
